questions.prompt: order_id has values [1, 2, 2, 3]. How many rows fail a unique test?
questions.explanation: Both rows with order_id 2 fail. You can't tell which duplicate is correct, so every copy is flagged.

questions.prompt: A new, unexpected status value appears in the source. Which severity usually fits an accepted_values test on it?
options: warn: load and alert so a human can decide
questions.explanation: A new category may be legitimate, so it's usually a warning that alerts someone. Primary-key uniqueness, on the other hand, should be an error.

questions.prompt: When should an incremental pipeline advance its watermark?
options: Never; recompute it from scratch each time
questions.explanation: Advance it only after a successful load. If the run fails, the next run re-reads the same rows and the idempotent upsert makes that safe.
